content.comment_body: Hello, I'm currently using [article_no] and inserted an 8GB MicroSD card formatted as FAT32. I want to log two analog values, but the logs remain in the device ROM and don't transfer to the SD card. I am unsure how to fix it, although it used to work. Here is the variable archive. Thank you in advance.
Could you upload your program as a ZIP file?

I uploaded your program to my [product_name] and started it. A Data Log was created, and I was able to download it. What exactly is the issue? Is there no Data Log? If so, there may be an issue with your SD card. Or is the Data Log showing incorrect data? Also, your Parameter VM Mapping list has overlapping addresses: a VW (word) uses two bytes, so VW1 = VB1 and VB2, VW2 = VB2 and VB3, meaning both words write into VB2. Edit: Data Log attached.

Thank you for your response. I am occasionally able to retrieve data from the ROM, with the most recent data available from last week. The SD card was working two weeks ago. I am unsure what changed to cause this issue. The PLC records two variables each minute, but now, the last recording is from a week ago and only for a short period; afterwards, logging stopped. PS: I also use [product_name Access Tool].
I am not sure if it is possible to perform Data Logging and use [product_name Access Tool] simultaneously; I have never tried it. For this situation, consider starting a support request.

Hi, try using an MSD card from another manufacturer. Check if your device can use the MSD card: if it's unsupported, it will be indicated in the diagnostic menu of the device/[product_name Operator Device]. Hope this helps.

I discovered that data logging works fine without the mSD card, and the mSD card can store and upload the program to the device. It seems some parameter changes have made using the card for logging impossible.
Hi, have you tried using MSD cards from a different manufacturer?

analysis.insight_summary: Users report inconsistent data logging with [product_name Basis Module]. Records are sporadically written to the SD card, even though the function previously worked. The SD card remains usable for storing and transferring programs but not for ongoing data logging, causing confusion. Factors such as SD card compatibility, configuration changes, and simultaneous use of different software tools affect logging reliability, but no clear solution is identified.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name Basis Module] to dependably record and keep the necessary data on the SD card, as it did in the past, regardless of unknown recent changes. They are searching for reliable and consistent data logging performance without interruptions.
